resources.string: Everything Android lets an app read about this box, saved as .txt and .json in Download.

Press OK on Create report. It takes a few seconds and asks for location (to show the Wi-Fi name) and storage (to save to Download); both are optional.

For the system log, dumpsys and app usage, grant these once from a PC and create the report again:

adb shell pm grant com.mazem3dia.devicereport android.permission.READ_LOGS
adb shell pm grant com.mazem3dia.devicereport android.permission.DUMP
adb shell appops set com.mazem3dia.devicereport GET_USAGE_STATS allow
